text:
nina-sales: HarborData POC stuck — encoder returning 2048-dim vectors but their search index is 1536. Also seeing occasional 413 Payload Too Large from their batch uploads and 429 rate limits. Need a quick swarm to unblock customer today.

omar-se: Can we confirm which model they're calling and whether they changed any internal preprocessing? They mentioned switching to a community encoder last week.

nina-sales: Customer claims code uses `redwood-embed-1536` everywhere. Their CI logs show a different binary for a microservice `hd-encoder` that might be on an older image.

devin-eng-ml: Common failure modes: 1) model mismatch (model actually returns 2048) 2) local concat/pooling bug 3) they reindexed DB incorrectly. For 413/429: likely batch_size or single request too large. Ask for a minimal repro request and the raw HTTP request/response body.

tara-support: HarborData account is on Sandbox tier; sandbox keys have a 60 req/min burst and 10MB payload limit per request. 413 indicates payload > limit. Recommend reducing per-request documents or compressing payloads.

nina-sales: I uploaded their anonymized request/response pair to S3: https://s3.internal/harbordata/poc/trace-0311.json

omar-se: Quick check: run model metadata endpoint: `GET /v1/models/redwood-embed-1536/meta` — that'll return embedding_dim. Also check `hd-encoder` container logs for env var MODEL_OVERRIDE or a hardcoded model name.

nina-sales: Customer ran metadata check — API says embedding_dim: 2048 for the model their hd-encoder resolves to. So their service is pointing at `redwood-embed-2048` behind the scenes.

devin-eng-ml: Two paths: short-term fix = reindex to 2048 or switch encoder to 1536. Medium = add tolerant ingest that rejects mismatched dims with clear error. I'll draft a small error text change that returns expected_dim and provided_dim.

tara-support: For immediate mitigation I've suggested: 1) reduce batch to 16 docs 2) gzip payloads (we accept gzip) 3) implement exponential backoff on 429s. Sent sample client patch in DM.

omar-se: On pricing and enterprise ask — if they permanently move to 2048 dims, pricing impact ~2x embed cost. Sales should flag to finance and offer a Dedicated capacity estimate if they need low latency and consistent throughput.

nina-sales: Noted. I'll loop in finance and draft a Dedicated TCO. They also asked about security questionnaire answers for Dedicated (SOC2 and private VPC).

devin-eng-ml: I'll open a PR for the enhanced dims-mismatch error. infra-bot, can we schedule a small hotfix deploy to staging?

infra-bot: Queued deploy #4987 (staging) — includes dims mismatch diagnostics. ETA 12 minutes.

nina-sales: Customer chose to reindex to 2048 to move faster. They're running a small reindex job now, will retest after. I scheduled a 25m sync in 40m.

tara-support: Follow-ups: I created a short KB for customers on embedding batch sizing and common dim issues and linked the SDK patch for python 0.9.x which fixes a caching error that can mask model changes.

omar-se: Also added a note to the model registry to warn when models with same prefix differ in dims (automation rule).

nina-sales: Thanks team — will update HarborData after sync. :thumbsup:
